builds.name: Reference: Range and poke
builds.goal: Reference for Xerath: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A long-range artillery mage who charges beams, slows targets into skillshots and uses successive ultimate shots to finish from safety. Measure skillshot hit rate and successive R shots from a safe position. Maximum-range Comet and an uninterrupted full R volley cannot be granted on demand. Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
builds.summary: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
testPlan: Kit question for Xerath: Measure skillshot hit rate and successive R shots from a safe position. Maximum-range Comet and an uninterrupted full R volley cannot be granted on demand.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Horizon) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.

The route fails Xerath's stated kit question: Measure skillshot hit rate and successive R shots from a safe position. Maximum-range Comet and an uninterrupted full R volley cannot be granted on demand.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.
Full cost 16,050 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Luden, then Horizon. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Xerath ascends to his true form and channels for [10] seconds. During this time he may Recast up to [4 / 5 / 6] times.

Recast: Xerath launches a magical artillery, dealing [170 / 220 / 270 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage. For each champion hit, the artillery deals an additional [20 / 25 / 30 + (0.05) × AP] magic damage.

Begin Charging: Xerath begins charging an arcane beam, Slowing himself gradually up to 50%. 

Release: Xerath fires the beam, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage. The range increases with time charged.
Xerath fires an orb of raw magic, Stunning the first enemy hit for up to [2.25] seconds based on distance travelled, and dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage.

Every 16 seconds Xerath's next Attack against a champion restores [(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=3, changes=[{"mLevel": 4, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 9.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 12.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])) × (2)] Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced by [3.5] seconds.

Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing [50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and Slowing them by [25]% for [2.5] seconds. Enemies in the center take [(50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.65) × AP) × (1.667)] magic damage instead and are Slowed by [(0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × 100]%, decaying over [2.5] seconds.
